title: Affine refinement of proper inverse-system construction
statement: theorem proper_limit_noetherian_affine_clause {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (hS : IsAffine S) (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)) (Xs Ss : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (fs : Xs ⟶ Ss) (πX : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj X ⟶ Xs) (πS : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj S ⟶ Ss) (hlimX : Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk X πX))) (hlimS : Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk S πS))) : (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, IsAffine (Ss.obj i) ∧ RingHom.FiniteType (algebraMap ℤ (Scheme.Γ.obj (Opposite.op (Ss.obj i))))) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Scheme.Γ.mapCocone (Cone.mk S πS).op))
